context:
PR 963 and PR 969 passed review (Sonnet reviewer). PR 958 is already green. PRs 966, 968 and 970 are docs and config only, and their docs audit passes.
Draft PRs skip CI, so none of the six has a full run yet. The batch makes one integration branch with one CI run, then merges only if it is green. A lane whose job fails is dropped and fixed apart.

options.gain: All six land in one CI run.
options.how: One integration PR with the six lanes, one CI run, then `make merge` on green.
options.label: Batch all six, merge on green
options.lose: One red lane delays the rest by one re-run.

options.how: Batch only the two DEBT61 PRs; the other four wait.
options.label: Only 963 and 969

title: Batch these six PRs and merge them once CI is green?
